primary_title: Structure of active beta-arrestin-1 bound to a G-protein-coupled receptor phosphopeptide
decision_basis: The primary structure and pull-down assays support direct binding of the V2R pS357/pT360/pS363 phosphosite-set to beta-arrestin1.
limitations_preserved: Preserve the human V2R phosphopeptide, exact pS357/pT360/pS363 site-set and beta-arrestin1/Fab30 structural context; no whole-cell desensitization, universal AVPR2, SCI or terminal-TF expansion.
